metadata.technology_specification: Male Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV)
metadata.technology_reasoning: Male ISR UAVs represent the most common and standardized category of unmanned aerial systems used by military forces globally, characterized by medium-altitude, medium-endurance capabilities with versatile payload configurations for surveillance missions, widely adopted as of 2024.

Airframe Structure.name: Aluminum
Airframe Structure.reasoning: Primary structural metal widely used for UAV airframes due to its strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance; standard industry practice.

Airframe Structure.name: Carbon
Airframe Structure.reasoning: Used as carbon fiber composite reinforcement in advanced airframes for high stiffness and low weight; commonly used though aluminum alternatives exist.

Airframe Structure.name: Glass
Airframe Structure.reasoning: Used as fiberglass composite matrix material for structural panels; common polymer matrix combined with carbon fibers in composites.

Airframe Structure.name: Steel Ingots
Airframe Structure.reasoning: Used in critical strengthening elements and fasteners in airframe; alternatives exist but steel is common for durability.

Airframe Structure.name: Titanium
Airframe Structure.reasoning: Utilized in high-stress parts for its high strength and corrosion resistance; used in military UAVs though less common due to cost.

Propulsion System (Turboprop or Rotary E.name: Steel Ingots
Propulsion System (Turboprop or Rotary E.reasoning: Essential for engine shafts, gears, and structural components due to high strength and wear resistance; universally used.

Propulsion System (Turboprop or Rotary E.name: Aluminum
Propulsion System (Turboprop or Rotary E.reasoning: Used in engine casing and turbine components for lightweight and good thermal properties; standard choice.

Propulsion System (Turboprop or Rotary E.name: Titanium
Propulsion System (Turboprop or Rotary E.reasoning: Used in turbine blades and critical parts for strength at high temperature; common in aviation engines though expensive.

Propulsion System (Turboprop or Rotary E.name: Nickel
Propulsion System (Turboprop or Rotary E.reasoning: Used in superalloys for turbine blades for corrosion and temperature resistance; common though alternatives like cobalt exist.

Avionics Suite.name: Silicon
Avionics Suite.reasoning: Fundamental semiconductor material for microprocessors and integrated circuits; absolutely essential for avionics electronics.

Avionics Suite.name: Copper
Avionics Suite.reasoning: Used for electrical wiring and PCB traces due to excellent electrical conductivity; standard industry choice.

Avionics Suite.name: Gold
Avionics Suite.reasoning: Used for wire bonding and corrosion-resistant contacts; critical for high-reliability electronics though expensive.

Avionics Suite.name: Aluminum
Avionics Suite.reasoning: Employed in heat sinks and structural housings for lightweight thermal management.

Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.name: Germanium
Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.reasoning: Key optical material for infrared sensor lenses due to high IR transparency; standard in EO/IR sensors.

Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.name: Silicon
Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.reasoning: Used as photodetector material and electronic components; extensively used in EO sensors.

Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.name: Indium
Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.reasoning: Component of indium tin oxide coatings used for transparent conductive layers in sensor electronics.

Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.name: Glass
Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.reasoning: Lens and protective window material in visible spectrums; optical glass is standard.

Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.name: Aluminum
Surveillance Payload (Electro-Optical/In.reasoning: Used in sensor housing and structural parts for lightweight and strength.

Communication System (Data Link).name: Silicon
Communication System (Data Link).reasoning: Primary semiconductor for RF circuits and processing electronics; essential for communication system.

Communication System (Data Link).name: Copper
Communication System (Data Link).reasoning: Widely used for wiring, antennas, and PCB traces due to excellent electrical conductivity.

Communication System (Data Link).name: Gallium
Communication System (Data Link).reasoning: Used in compound semiconductors (e.g., gallium arsenide) for high-frequency RF components; common though silicon alternatives exist.

Communication System (Data Link).name: Glass
Communication System (Data Link).reasoning: Utilized in substrates and packaging glasses for fiber optic components; less universal but possible.

Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.name: Lithium
Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.reasoning: Critical element for lithium-ion batteries which are common in UAV power systems; no commercial alternative for this chemistry.

Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.name: Cobalt
Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.reasoning: Used in battery cathodes to improve energy density; common but alternatives like LFP exist.

Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.name: Copper
Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.reasoning: Electrical conductor for battery current collectors and wiring; universally used.

Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.name: Aluminum
Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.reasoning: Current collector and casing material in batteries; standard industry practice.

Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.name: Nickel
Power Supply System (Batteries or Auxili.reasoning: Used in battery cathodes for improved performance; common though some chemistries do not use nickel.

Landing Gear Assembly.name: Steel Ingots
Landing Gear Assembly.reasoning: Primary structural and load-bearing material for landing gear due to high strength and toughness.

Landing Gear Assembly.name: Aluminum
Landing Gear Assembly.reasoning: Used for lightweight parts and housings in the landing gear assembly where strength allows; common but secondary.

Landing Gear Assembly.name: Titanium
Landing Gear Assembly.reasoning: Used selectively in high-stress components for strength and corrosion resistance; cost limits widespread use.

Onboard Mission Computer.name: Silicon
Onboard Mission Computer.reasoning: Fundamental semiconductor material for CPUs, memory, and other ICs in mission computers; universally required.

Onboard Mission Computer.name: Copper
Onboard Mission Computer.reasoning: Used for PCB traces and internal wiring due to excellent conductivity; standard in electronics.

Onboard Mission Computer.name: Gold
Onboard Mission Computer.reasoning: Used in wire bonds and contacts for reliability and corrosion resistance; common in high-reliability electronic components.

Onboard Mission Computer.name: Aluminum
Onboard Mission Computer.reasoning: Used in heat sinks and casing for thermal management and structural support.
